name: io.github.FouadHELLAL7/datto-edr-mcp
title: Datto EDR
description: MCP server for Datto EDR (Infocyte) — agents, alerts, target groups, organizations, scans and rules.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_EDR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Datto EDR instance base URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.infocyte.com

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects X-Datto-EDR-URL and X-Datto-EDR-API-Token headers from the MCP gateway.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_EDR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide the scan, isolate, restore and response tools.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
